slo_title: Compare shared vs distributed memory architectures

mcq.q: 5. Why are architecture-specific designs important in parallel computing?

options.A: A) They limit performance for complex systems
options.B: B) They help optimize execution based on hardware constraints and concurrency models
options.C: C) They eliminate the need for synchronization

mcq.answer_text: B) They help optimize execution based on hardware constraints and concurrency models

mcq.q: 1. Which of the following best defines parallel computing?

options.A: A) Executing a program in sequential steps only
options.B: B) Running multiple tasks at the same time to improve performance
options.C: C) Compressing programs for faster execution
options.D: D) Storing all data in one location

mcq.answer_text: B) Running multiple tasks at the same time to improve performance

mcq.q: 3. Which of the following is a key difference between shared and distributed memory systems?

options.A: A) Distributed systems do not support concurrency
options.B: B) Shared memory systems require a network interface
options.C: C) Distributed memory systems use message passing for communication
options.D: D) Shared memory systems are not used in parallel computing

mcq.answer_text: C) Distributed memory systems use message passing for communication

mcq.q: 4. Which parallel computing model involves independent processors with their own local memory communicating via messages?

options.A: A) Have no access to each other’s memory
options.B: B) Use a network to communicate
options.C: C) Share a common memory space and communicate via that memory
options.D: D) Use message passing for data sharing

mcq.answer_text: C) Share a common memory space and communicate via that memory

sq.q: When would a distributed memory model be better than shared memory?
answer: Distributed memory is suitable for geographically separated or high-scale systems. Each node works independently and communicates via messages. It avoids memory bottlenecks and allows horizontal scaling.

sq.q: A weather simulation runs on a supercomputer. Why choose parallel programming?
answer: Parallel programming allows simultaneous execution of multiple parts of the simulation. This drastically reduces computation time for large datasets. It also utilizes hardware resources more effectively.
